memories.title: Project uses modular architecture
memories.content: Detected modules: cli, mcp-server, agent-intelligence, agent-workflow, ai-memory, ai-provider, config, cursor-integration, embeddings, knowledge-graph, memory-engine, observability. Prefer keeping boundaries between modules.
